summary: This note sets out Zenith Innovations Inc.'s top 10 inclusive workplace policies, presented as ideas any company can adopt to embrace diversity and stand against discrimination and harassment. The policies cover hiring, training, flexibility, parental leave, employee groups, reporting, pay equity, cultural events and leadership accountability. The company describes these as living, evolving policies and says it aims to be an ethical and social trailblazer.
one_line: Zenith Innovations Inc. lists ten inclusive workplace policies, from blind recruitment to leadership accountability, to promote diversity and counter discrimination and harassment.
key_facts: Zenith Innovations Inc. says a diverse and inclusive environment is essential to driving creativity, innovation, and growth.

Zenith Innovations Inc. uses a blind recruitment process that removes names, ages, genders, and other identifying information from applications so screening focuses on skills, capabilities, and experience.
Zenith Innovations Inc. holds regular inclusive language training sessions to foster respect for each individual's identity and experiences.
Zenith Innovations Inc. offers flexible work arrangements for all staff, including remote work options, flexible hours, and consideration for personal or family-related time off.
Zenith Innovations Inc. offers equitable parental leave for all parents regardless of gender, including adoption and foster care situations.
Zenith Innovations Inc. encourages Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) for women, LGBTQ+ employees, people of color, and other groups.
Zenith Innovations mandates regular anti-discrimination and anti-harassment training for all members of its team.
Zenith Innovations Inc. has a clear, confidential, and easy-to-use reporting process for discrimination or harassment, so employees can raise concerns without fear of retribution.
Zenith Innovations conducts annual pay equity audits to check for pay disparity across gender, race, or other demographic lines.
Zenith Innovations hosts events honoring different cultural holidays, histories, and cuisines so employees can share their heritage.
Zenith Innovations Inc.'s leadership team is held accountable for diversity and inclusion goals embedded in the company's key performance indicators.
Zenith Innovations Inc. leaders undergo specialized training and are evaluated on their efforts to create a diverse and inclusive team.
Zenith Innovations Inc. describes its anti-discrimination and anti-harassment measures as living, evolving policies and aspires to be an ethical and social trailblazer.
